fields.label: Background
fields.text: Lúnasa is launching an alcohol-free version of its cider.

fields.label: Objectives
fields.text: Trial among people who cut back on alcohol this year.

fields.label: Audience
fields.text: Moderate drinkers in their thirties who still go out most weekends.

fields.label: Insight
fields.text: Nobody wants to be the person with the odd drink in their hand.

fields.label: Single-minded proposition
fields.text: The same round, the same good time.

fields.label: Mandatories
fields.text:
0.0% ABV on the front of pack
No health claims
